name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-02-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.64 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
